royal_armory_total_upgrade_levels.description: Independent owned-level total across the full saved Royal upgrade catalog, including non-displayed records

royal_armory_unlocked_upgrade_count.description: Independent unlocked displayed-upgrade count, capped by the game's display list

royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_display_0.description: Game caller's displayed-prefix predicate for Collect Resources Tool (catalog 30, display 0); unlock is separate from price and purchase cap

royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_display_5.description: Game caller's displayed-prefix predicate for Royal Marble (catalog 41, display 5), not catalog position 5

royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_display_6.description: Game caller's displayed-prefix predicate for Resource Replenish (catalog 70, display 6), not catalog position 6

royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_last_unloc.expression: (() => { const count = idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgUNLOCKED", 0, 0); return count - 1 < count; })()
royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_last_unloc.description: Game caller's strict displayed-prefix predicate at the current last unlocked position (fresh game count minus one); test resolves catalog identity from independently source-verified static display mapping

royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_first_lock.expression: (() => { const count = idleon.callFunction("RoyalG", "ArmoryUpgUNLOCKED", 0, 0); return count < count; })()
royal_armory_upgrade_unlocked_first_lock.description: Game caller's strict displayed-prefix predicate at the current first locked position (fresh game count); test resolves catalog identity from independently source-verified static display mapping
